page.overview:
Who is Blake?

Blake is a student at Springfield Elementary School.

Blake is a young boy with thick curly brown hair. He has naturally red eyes that he covers with blue contacts to look sweet and gentle. He dresses in an orange V-neck sweatshirt over a white shirt, blue jeans and grey sneakers.
